description:
[Calculators] Sheep and cow breeding odds: genes, inbreeding, twins, wool/milk. The animal breeder page's maths (https://rust.wiki/calculators/animal-breeder). Each gene has two copies and the
animal shows the better one; the young gets one random copy of each gene from each parent, so `young_odds` per
gene is the chance it shows good / ok / bad. It also gets one random family mark from each parent and is inbred
when they match (`chance_inbred`; null when marks weren't given). `chance_all_good_not_inbred`, `chance_twins`
(needs a good-fertility mother) and `expected_product_per_hour` (wool or milk, inbreeding counted) follow. Gene
numbers come from fan tools that read the game files (`gene_confidence`).

mother.description: Mother's genes: comma-separated `gene:copy/copy`, gene D (Dung), Y (Yield), F (Fertility) or H (Hardiness), copies good/ok/bad. Genes left out are ok/ok.
